verdict.rationale: Weaviate offers its own isolated environments for testing: an always-free cloud cluster, a local Docker deployment, and an embedded mode, each separate from any production instance. Multi-tenancy also provides per-tenant data isolation. However, nothing in the evidence describes a named sandbox or staging feature, or a workflow for cloning production state safely into a test environment. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox/staging environment feature, documented production-to-test data seeding, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Always free — 1 cluster per user, upgrade to paid anytime.
You can easily start Weaviate and a local vector embedding model with Docker.
You can even run Weaviate as an embedded python package rather than a separate process
Multi-tenancy provides data isolation. Each tenant is stored on a separate shard. Data stored in one tenant is not visible to another tenant.
